meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把关分析检测方法是否经得起验证审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要给实验室检测方法准备验证和证明材料。
copy.tagline_en: Prove your lab method is reliable for its intended use before release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must show an analytical method is fit for its intended purpose under regulations.

howto.what: Claude 按 ICH Q2(R2)、ICH M10、USP 等框架帮你规划分析方法验证/确认/转移方案，用自带脚本算线性、准确度精密度、检出限、方法比对等统计并生成文档；它只报告，不判定方法合格。
howto.when: 当你提到“方法验证”“AMV”“验收标准”等词，或要评估某方法是否适合预期用途时触发。

say.text: 帮我按 ICH Q2(R2) 为 HPLC 含量测定生成一份验证方案。
say.note: 会列出所需特性与待填的验收标准字段。

say.text: 用这套校准数据检查线性，并给出回算误差和失拟检验。
say.note: 输出各级别回算误差与失拟 p 值。

say.text: 比较两种方法的配对数据，在 2% 裕度下做等效性检验。

howto.what_en: Claude plans analytical procedure validation, verification or transfer under your chosen framework, runs bundled Python scripts for linearity, accuracy/precision and detection limits, and writes the docs. Scripts report; none conclude.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention method validation, acceptance criteria, method transfer or the like, or need to show an assay is fit for its intended purpose.

say_en.text: Draft an ICH Q2(R2) validation protocol for an HPLC assay.
say_en.note: Lists required characteristics and open criteria fields.

say_en.text: Check my calibration data for linearity and back-calculated error.
say_en.note: Reports per-level error and lack-of-fit p.

say_en.text: Compare two methods at a 2% margin with equivalence testing.
say_en.note: Gives TOST result plus Deming and Passing-Bablok slopes.
